_what: The facts kept about a file (the namespace result of `result_kind`), as the fields Files and Media show, sort, group and filter by. Read by src/workspace/file-facts.mjs. A new fact is one row in `fields`: `id` is its name in the facts value, `kind` one of `kinds` (which picks its filter comparisons through `rule_kind` and how it is written through `show`), `else` the values read when the fact is absent (`fact`: another fact, `row`: a field the screen's own row carries), `editable` lets the person change it in the list. A fact that has no row here (one an AI or the person added) still shows, as a field of the kind its value reads as, hidden until chosen. `quiet` names facts used by the readers rather than displayed as editable fields: `read_from_file` is when the file's own bytes were last read, and `media_tracks` records actual WebM sound/picture TrackType entries. `person_kinds` are the kinds a person picks from when adding a field of their own; `person_fields_preference` is where those fields are kept for them across devices.
